acceptance: A validation bounded context is exported and contains domain, application, infrastructure, interface, and acl layers.

The domain model retains a T0 baseline with company identity, supplied Stage text, Evidence IDs, hypotheses, counter evidence, missing proof, and peer baseline, plus observations at exactly the 6-month, 12-month, and 24-month horizons with the five validation dimensions from VALIDATION_STRATEGY.md, opaque metrics, evidence references, and source quality.
Blank required values, duplicate evidence IDs, duplicate metric names, duplicate horizons, and duplicate company records are rejected without mutating the existing record/store.
The application evaluator reports only missing validation horizons and completeness; it does not calculate Stage, score, ranking, thresholds, or investment claims.
The validation strategy, implementation specification, and roadmap include an explicit evidence-retention boundary and retain production/runtime/full-universe limitations.

The focused domain/store tests report zero failures; the architecture and project-quality commands report success; every required AI Cockpit check is recorded as passed; the hosted PR checks are successful before merge; archive, ai-close-work-item, and final clean-state inspections provide their required evidence.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.
Evidence before interpretation: preserve opaque facts and references; do not derive research judgments in this boundary.
Do not claim external provider or production behavior was verified without a real authorized receipt.

intent.problem: The PRD and validation strategy require a T0 baseline followed by 6-month, 12-month, and 24-month validation evidence, but the repository has no validation bounded context, typed retention record, duplicate-safety boundary, or completeness assessment. The existing runtime deliberately stops at opaque/precomputed facts and does not assign Stage, score companies, or rank them.
constraints: Implement only typed evidence retention and completeness/readiness assessment; do not calculate or infer Stage, score, ranking, thresholds, investment claims, or economic significance.
Preserve supplied strings, evidence references, metrics, units, and source quality without arithmetic or normalization beyond blank/duplicate validation.
Use the four documented horizons: T0 baseline, SixMonths, TwelveMonths, and TwentyFourMonths; reject duplicate horizons and duplicate company records.
Keep the bounded context independent from other feature internals and satisfy the five-layer architecture contract.
Complete the full AI Cockpit Work Item lifecycle; external production operations remain prohibited.
intent.rationale: A pure retention boundary is the smallest deterministic implementation that turns the validation document from unenforced prose into a typed, testable contract while preserving the explicit product boundary against invented judgment.
